messages:
ops-bot: ALERT: SLO anomaly detected for /v1/generate — sudden quality regressions correlated with recent cost-routing policy rollout.  Error rate +2.3%, median BLEU (internal) drop 8% in last 12m. Tripping P1 thresholds. @micah (pager) :rotating_light:
micah (oncall): on it, paging SRE + ML. can someone post quick customer impact? which tenants?
sara-customer: seeing multiple customer complaints about hallucinations and incorrect invoice numbers since ~10:12 UTC. two mid-market customers reported 5+ bad responses. not all tenants hit.
devin-ml: adding context — we applied cost-routing policy CR-2026-07 at 09:45 UTC that routes <=50ms latency requests to "redwood-mini-quant-v1" (low-cost variant) if cost savings >30%. Telemetry now shows 42% of requests matched and were routed.
luis-sre: pulling routing logs now. snippet from routing decision point (kv):
```
[2026-07-14T10:11:57Z] request_id=abc123 route_policy=CR-2026-07 decision=variant=redwood-mini-quant-v1 reason=cost_threshold match=true
[2026-07-14T10:12:05Z] request_id=abc456 route_policy=CR-2026-07 decision=fallback=redwood-2.0x reason=latency_violation
```
cecilia-eng: fwiw the mini-quant only passed unit quality gates at short sequences; we flagged potential regressions on long-form invoice templates during internal eval but considered acceptable trade-off for embedding workloads. looks like routing criteria too broad.
micah (oncall): severity -> P1. immediate mitigation options? suggestions: 1) disable CR-2026-07; 2) narrow match criteria; 3) force fallback to stable model for affected tenants.
devin-ml: recommend disable and rollout emergency rule to pin known affected tenants to redwood-2.0x. I'll prepare the policy change.
luis-sre: I'm going to flip the policy flag in the control plane now. executing:
```
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"
  https://control-plane.internal/api/policies/CR-2026-07/disable
```
ops-bot: ACTION: policy CR-2026-07 disabled by luis-sre at 2026-07-14T10:15:03Z. Routing decisions reverting to default rules.
micah (oncall): confirm % of traffic reverted?
luis-sre: checking metrics... system shows routing delta: before disable 42% matched -> after disable 3% matched (edge races). request volume routing to mini-quant dropped from 36k/min to 2.5k/min in 30s.
sara-customer: seeing immediate improvement on tenant A. hallucination rate appears to drop. still seeing some bad ones from yesterday cache.
devin-ml: deploying emergency pin for tenant IDs: tenant-A, tenant-B, tenant-C to redwood-2.0x. patch:
```
POST /v1/routes/overrides
{ "tenants": ["A","B","C"], "model": "redwood-2.0x", "until": "2026-07-14T14:00:00Z" }
```
ops-bot: ACTION: override created by devin-ml at 2026-07-14T10:17:24Z.
cecilia-eng: sanity check — are we leaking keys or causing duplicates with overrides?
luis-sre: no duplicates. override is highest precedence and limited TTL. logs show override applied to 98% of requests for pinned tenants.
micah (oncall): good. assign owners for RCA and customer comms. devin-ml -> root cause and model gating. luis-sre -> rollout and infra safeguards. cecilia-eng -> prompts/eval regression triage. sara-customer -> customer updates. I'll do incident notes and handoff when shifting to postmortem.
pagerduty: Reminder — on-call handoff in 45m. next oncall: sara-customer? (auto)
sara-customer: I'll start drafting customer message. can we include ETA for full revert?
devin-ml: ETA for full traffic normalization ~10-20m. we'll keep overrides until policy rewrite is merged with stricter matchers (sequence length, workload tag).
cecilia-eng: temp test snippet to detect long-sequence invoice templates and mark not eligible for cost routing:
```
if prompt.tokens > 512 or prompt.contains("invoice") -> eligible=false
```
luis-sre: scheduling immediate alert rule: if model_variant != root_variant and customer-qa-drop > 5% -> auto-disable policy. will push config.
micah (oncall): great. create JIRA incident-1247 for mitigation and postmortem items. link please.
cecilia-eng: j-1247 created: https://jira.redwoodai/internal/browse/INC-1247
ops-bot: INCIDENT LOG: Severity=P1, start=2026-07-14T10:11:40Z, mitigated_partial=2026-07-14T10:17:24Z, mitigated_full=2026-07-14T10:35:00Z, owners=[devin-ml,luis-sre,cecilia-eng], postmortem=INC-1247
micah (oncall): handing off to devin-ml and luis-sre for post-incident. I'll be available for 30m for questions. :white_check_mark:
devin-ml: capturing notes for RCA: root cause = overly permissive cost-routing matcher (CR-2026-07) that didn't account for sequence-length and workload-specific quality sensitivity; secondary cause = rollout lacked canary for quality metrics on long prompts.
sara-customer: customers notified. CS flagged two enterprise accounts for follow-up with credits.
luis-sre: post-incident tasks: 1) add stricter pre-deploy checks for routing policies (unit tests + simulation), 2) implement auto-disable rule, 3) observability: add model-variant-specific quality heatmaps.
cecilia-eng: ML tasks: 1) tighten gating for quantized variants, 2) expand eval suite to include invoice and long-form templates, 3) tune prompt-sensitive thresholds.
micah (oncall): adding follow-ups to incident ticket. who will own the policy rewrite?
devin-ml: I'll take CR-2026-07 rewrite and do an RFC. aiming for merge in 3 days with canary plan.
sara-customer: can we confirm timeline for credits and outreach? I'll coordinate with CS.
ops-bot: STATUS: incident transitioned to postmortem phase at 2026-07-14T11:05:00Z.
cecilia-eng: quick question — do we need to rollback the mini-quant image? or just tighten route policy?
devin-ml: no urgent rollback of image required; the variant will remain available for safe workloads. just policy change.
luis-sre: logging note — saw a small routing-loop earlier where fallback policies chained across regions for a few hundred requests. root cause tracked in RCA and will be patched.
micah (oncall): thanks team. leaving handoff note: OOO in 30, will check updates. make sure to @micah on the postmortem draft. :pray:
devin-ml: attaching quick diff I'll push to RFC: includes
- add sequence-length and workload tags to matcher
- require quality canary for 24h before enabling cost savings >20%
- circuit-breaker: if customer_quality_drop > 3% in 10m -> auto-disable

cecilia-eng: will run extended evals once RFC lands.
sara-customer: closing loop with customers now, will post summary in #customer-updates.
ops-bot: THREAD CLOSED (auto) — no active mitigations. final severity=P1, postmortem=jira/INC-1247, duration=~24m
